events.title: Coronation of Andrew III's rival era: Death of Andrew III of Hungary
events.description: Andrew III of Hungary, the last king of the Árpád dynasty, died on this date, reportedly in Buda, ending the male line of the dynasty that had ruled Hungary since the late 9th century.
events.significance: His death ended the Árpád dynasty and led to a period of dynastic struggle before the Angevin Charles I secured the Hungarian throne.

events.title: United States Ratifies the Treaty of Paris
events.description: The Congress of the Confederation, meeting in Annapolis, Maryland, ratified the Treaty of Paris, which had been negotiated with Great Britain to formally end the American Revolutionary War.
events.significance: Ratification formally ended the Revolutionary War and confirmed British recognition of American independence and the territorial boundaries of the new nation.

events.title: Treaty of Kiel
events.description: Denmark-Norway signed the Treaty of Kiel with Sweden and Britain, ceding Norway to the Swedish king in the aftermath of the Napoleonic Wars.
events.significance: The treaty dissolved the centuries-old union of Denmark and Norway and prompted Norway's declaration of independence and constitution in 1814, shaping modern Scandinavian borders.

events.title: Launch of NBC's Today Show
events.description: NBC aired the first episode of the Today show, hosted by Dave Garroway, in New York City, pioneering the morning television news and talk format.
events.significance: Today became one of the longest-running and most influential programs in American television history, establishing the template for morning news shows worldwide.

events.title: Accession of Queen Margrethe II of Denmark
events.description: Margrethe II became Queen of Denmark following the death of her father, King Frederik IX, becoming the first female monarch of Denmark since Margaret I in the early 15th century.
events.significance: Her accession followed a 1953 change to the succession law allowing women to inherit the throne, and she reigned for over 50 years until abdicating in 2024.
